NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Public URL of the deployment (Vercel sets this automatically via VERCEL_URL; set NEXTAUTH_URL explicitly to the production domain)

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string (Vercel Postgres, Neon, Supabase, etc.)

ZAI_API_KEY.description: Z.ai API key (powers all AI features)

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Random secret for JWT signing (openssl rand -base64 32)
